Backend Developer - Payments Platform
Tyro Payments, Melbourne (Hybrid)

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate REST and event-driven APIs for merchant payments
- Integrate with third-party acquirers and legacy SOAP/XML services
- Improve latency and reliability of checkout flows; add caching where it matters
- Review code for security issues (OWASP Top 10, PCI-DSS awareness)
- Work in a small squad with a tech lead, QA and a product owner

What you'll bring
- 2+ years building production backends in Python, Node.js or PHP
- Solid SQL (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and API design experience
- Experience with AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch)
- Clear written communication; comfortable mentoring junior developers

Nice to have
- E-commerce or payments domain experience
- FastAPI or Express.js
